query:
SELECT 
  branchId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') = '2026-05' THEN id END) as may_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') = '2026-06' THEN id END) as june_sales
FROM sales_transactions
WHERE branchId IN (20, 300012)
GROUP BY branchId;
